resources.string: This is the balance of all entries currently saved, including entries outside the selected dates. It is not an Inuka balance.
Days without delivery records are unknown and are excluded from this average.
Collected rent less recorded expenses. Deposits and unpaid rent are excluded; this is not profit or a cash balance.
This shows recording coverage, not proof that every transaction was entered. Missing days are unknown, not zero.
Compared with an equally long completed period
Change in recorded sales or earned amount
Original values and entry times are kept. Every correction or void needs a reason; a void does not erase the record.
Stock used for a recorded sale
This cost came from a buyer deduction. Void the linked payment to reverse it.
This receipt belongs to a fully paid sale. Void the sale to reverse both records together.
A void reverses the recorded totals and keeps the original record and reason. Linked payments may need to be corrected first.
Collected of expected means payments applied to the selected month. Summary shows money received within chosen dates.
This period includes dates after today. Figures show saved entries, not a forecast.
Correct litres here. To change buyer, date or price, void the delivery in History and enter its replacement.
